metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Beijing, Chongqing, and Wuhan all decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P NO2 (primary: COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2; fallback: COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2). Two periods: 2020-01-01 to 2020-01-21 and 2020-02-10 to 2020-02-26. Locations: 30 km buffers around centers of Beijing, Chongqing, and Wuhan.
2. Masking strategy: Apply quality mask qa_value >= 0.75; compute period mean images and reduce over city geometries.
3. Logic: If collections empty for either period after fallback → C1. If valid pixels count is 0 in any city for either period → C2. If any mean is null/NaN → C3. Otherwise, compare means; if all three decrease → A else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  function getInfo(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate(resolve, reject));
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const cities = [
    { name: 'Beijing', geom: ee.Geometry.Point([116.4074, 39.9042]).buffer(30000) },
    { name: 'Chongqing', geom: ee.Geometry.Point([106.5516, 29.5630]).buffer(30000) },
    { name: 'Wuhan', geom: ee.Geometry.Point([114.3055, 30.5928]).buffer(30000) }
  ];
  const p1 = { start: '2020-01-01', end: '2020-01-21' }; // Jan 1-20 (end exclusive)
  const p2 = { start: '2020-02-10', end: '2020-02-26' }; // Feb 10-25 (end exclusive)

  // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
  const primary = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2';
  const fallback = 'COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2';

  function loadCols(ds) {
    const base = ee.ImageCollection(ds);
    return {
      col1: base.filterDate(p1.start, p1.end),
      col2: base.filterDate(p2.start, p2.end)
    };
  }

  let dsUsed = primary;
  let cols = loadCols(primary);
  let p1Count = await getInfo(cols.col1.size());
  let p2Count = await getInfo(cols.col2.size());

  if ((p1Count === 0) || (p2Count === 0)) {
    cols = loadCols(fallback);
    dsUsed = fallback;
    p1Count = await getInfo(cols.col1.size());
    p2Count = await getInfo(cols.col2.size());
    if ((p1Count === 0) || (p2Count === 0)) {
      console.log('Empty collection for one or both periods.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
  }

  function qaMask(col) {
    return col.map(function(img) {
      const qa = img.select('qa_value');
      return img.updateMask(qa.gte(0.75))
                .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
                .rename('no2');
    });
  }

  const imgP1 = qaMask(cols.col1).mean();
  const imgP2 = qaMask(cols.col2).mean();

  // 3. Processing & pixel counts
  async function statsForCity(city) {
    const reducers = function(img) {
      const mean = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: city.geom,
        scale: 10000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('no2');
      const count = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: city.geom,
        scale: 10000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('no2');
      return ee.Dictionary({mean: mean, count: count});
    };
    const d1 = await getInfo(reducers(imgP1));
    const d2 = await getInfo(reducers(imgP2));
    return {
      name: city.name,
      p1Mean: d1 ? d1.mean : null,
      p1Count: d1 ? d1.count : 0,
      p2Mean: d2 ? d2.mean : null,
      p2Count: d2 ? d2.count : 0
    };
  }

  const results = [];
  for (const c of cities) {
    const r = await statsForCity(c);
    results.push(r);
  }

  // 4. Validation
  for (const r of results) {
    if (!r || r.p1Count === 0 || r.p2Count === 0) {
      console.log(`No valid pixels after masking in ${r ? r.name : 'city'}.`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (r.p1Mean === null || r.p2Mean === null || isNaN(r.p1Mean) || isNaN(r.p2Mean)) {
      console.log(`Calculation failed in ${r.name}.`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
  }

  // 5. Output concise stats and final answer
  function fmt(x) {
    return (x === null || x === undefined || isNaN(x)) ? 'null' : Number(x).toExponential(2);
  }

  console.log(`Dataset: ${dsUsed}, P1 imgs=${p1Count}, P2 imgs=${p2Count}`);
  let allDecrease = true;
  for (const r of results) {
    const delta = r.p2Mean - r.p1Mean;
    allDecrease = allDecrease && (delta < 0);
    console.log(`${r.name}: Jan mean=${fmt(r.p1Mean)} (pix=${r.p1Count}), Feb mean=${fmt(r.p2Mean)} (pix=${r.p2Count}), Δ=${fmt(delta)}`);
  }

  console.log(allDecrease ? 'A' : 'B');
}

async function initEE() {
  try {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
    });
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
    });
    await runAnalysis();
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${String(err).slice(0, 140)}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

initEE();
```
